entry.title: New: dsh-skin-nebula
entry.summary: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider. Exact install spec: github:lyq3/dsh-skin-nebula. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
